PARAMS = {
    "I1":       (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),     # inverter (front stage) current
    "If":       (7e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),     # follower current
    "gmid_n":   (20.0, 12.0, 26.0),      # inverter NMOS gm/Id
    "Ln":       (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":   (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # inverter PMOS gm/Id (sets Vm = vout_dc)
    "Lp":       (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_f":   (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),      # follower gm/Id
    "Lf":       (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_m":   (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),       # mirror gm/Id
    "Lm":       (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cf":       (3e-15, 0.5e-15, 10e-15),# feedback cap (damping)
    "zt_margin":(1.12, 1.02, 1.5),       # Zt margin over 112 dBohm
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1, If = p["I1"], p["If"]
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    gam = 0.8
    Ctail = 100e-12

    # ---- DC operating-point iteration ----
    vsd_p, vt, vds_n = 0.3, 0.2, 1.0
    for _ in range(4):
        mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(vsd_p, 0.1))
        vm = VDD - mp.vgs                       # inverter trip point = gate = vout DC
        mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I1, vds=max(vds_n, 0.1), vsb=max(vt, 0.0))
        vt = vm - mn.vgs                        # tail node
        mf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_f"], p["Lf"], If, vds=VDD - vm, vsb=vm)
        vx = vm + mf.vgs                        # gain node
        vsd_p = VDD - vx
        vds_n = vx - vt

    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], iref, vds=0.6)
    for _ in range(2):
        mr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], iref, vds=mr.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], I1, vds=max(vt, 0.1))
    ms = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], If, vds=vm)

    # ---- small-signal nodal model [vi, vx, vo, vt] ----
    Cgd1 = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    Cin = cpd + mn.cgg + mp.cgg - Cgd1
    Cx = mn.cdd + mp.cdd + mf.cgd
    Cgsf = max(mf.cgg - mf.cgd, 0.0)
    Cout = cl + ms.cdd
    Cf = p["Cf"]

    def Ymat(f, Rf):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Gf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.zeros((4, 4), dtype=complex)
        Y[0] = [s * Cin + Gf + s * Cgd1, -s * Cgd1, -Gf, 0]
        Y[1] = [mn.gm + mp.gm - s * Cgd1,
                mn.gds + mp.gds + s * (Cx + Cgd1 + Cgsf),
                -s * Cgsf,
                -(mn.gm + mn.gmbs + mn.gds)]
        Y[2] = [-Gf, -mf.gm - s * Cgsf,
                mf.gm + mf.gmbs + mf.gds + ms.gds + s * (Cout + Cgsf) + Gf, 0]
        Y[3] = [-mn.gm, -mn.gds, 0, mn.gm + mn.gmbs + mn.gds + mt.gds + s * Ctail]
        return Y

    def zt(f, Rf):
        v = np.linalg.solve(Ymat(f, Rf), np.array([1, 0, 0, 0], dtype=complex))
        return v[2]

    zt_tgt = 10 ** (112 / 20) * p["zt_margin"]
    Rf = zt_tgt
    for _ in range(4):
        Rf *= zt_tgt / abs(zt(1e3, Rf))
    Rf = min(max(Rf, 1e3), 1e9)

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3, Rf))
    freqs = np.logspace(3, 10, 1400)
    mags = np.array([abs(zt(f, Rf)) for f in freqs])
    f3db = freqs[-1]
    for i in range(1, len(freqs)):
        if mags[i] < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            a, b = mags[i - 1], mags[i]
            t = (a - z0 / math.sqrt(2)) / max(a - b, 1e-30)
            f3db = freqs[i - 1] * (freqs[i] / freqs[i - 1]) ** t
            break

    # ---- noise at 1 MHz (referred to the photodiode node) ----
    fN = 1e6
    Yn = Ymat(fN, Rf)
    ztn = abs(zt(fN, Rf))
    srcs = [  # (psd, injection vector)
        (kT4 / Rf,                  [1, 0, -1, 0]),
        (kT4 * gam * mn.gm,         [0, 1, 0, -1]),
        (kT4 * gam * mp.gm,         [0, 1, 0, 0]),
        (kT4 * gam * mf.gm,         [0, 0, 1, 0]),
        (kT4 * gam * ms.gm,         [0, 0, 1, 0]),
        (kT4 * gam * mt.gm,         [0, 0, 0, 1]),
    ]
    vo2 = 0.0
    for psd, inj in srcs:
        v = np.linalg.solve(Yn, np.array(inj, dtype=complex))
        vo2 += psd * abs(v[2]) ** 2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(vo2) / ztn

    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + If)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("Mtail", "t", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mn", "x", "iin", "t", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("Mp", "x", "iin", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("Mf", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", mf)
    n.dev("Msink", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ms)
    n.C("Ctail", "t", "vss", Ctail)
    n.R("Rf", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("Cf", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vm,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
        "vt_tail": vt, "vsd_p": vsd_p, "vx": vx, "Rf": Rf,
    }
